text:
𝗣𝗛𝗜𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗣𝗦 𝗦𝗛𝗢𝗪! 🇳🇿

Glenn Phillips smashed 107 off 49 (10 sixes) as NZ made 259/7 at Eden Park.

India were 172/9, lost by 87 runs, but lead the series 3-1 🔥

#Cricket #INDvNZ

👉 Eden Park mein NZ ne 259/7 banaye
👉 Glenn Phillips: 107 (49 balls), 10 chhakke
👉 Bracewell ne 25 gend mein 65 jode
👉 India 172/9 par ruki, 87 run se haar
👉 Phir bhi series mein India 3-1 se aage

Phillips ki ye pari kaisi lagi? Comment karo 👇
